about: Texts of this mod's conquest (merged into the game's table; English where a language has none).

strings.conquest intro 12: Spring 1962. The war ended in armistices nobody trusts. Berlin rules Europe to the Volga, Tokyo the Pacific shore of Asia, Washington the Americas; the Non-Aligned keep apart, and beyond the Urals the heirs of the Soviet state fight over its ruins. The truces will not last: the Pacific in round 10, the Atlantic in round 15, the Axis itself in round 25.
strings.conquest country intro 12 de: The Reich of 1962 stretches from the Atlantic Wall to the Volga. Its army is tired, its satellites restless, and beyond the Urals the Soviet remnant still fights.
strings.conquest country victory 12 de: Defeat every country at war with you or bound to be. Countries at lasting peace with you need not fall.

strings.conquest 12 relation 1 end: Round 10. A Japanese convoy has been sunk off Midway and Tokyo blames Washington. The Pacific truce is over: the Co-Prosperity Sphere and the Atlantic Alliance are at war.
strings.conquest 12 relation 2 end: Round 15. The Berlin talks on the Atlantic islands have collapsed. The Berlin Pact and the Atlantic Alliance are at war.
strings.conquest 12 relation 3 end: Round 25. Berlin and Tokyo have fallen out over Central Asia and the oil of Persia. The Axis is no more: the Berlin Pact and the Co-Prosperity Sphere are at war.
